svg.aria-label: Versions A and B on a shared 36-second scale. Upper voices are identical. A dashed outline marks 14 to 20 seconds. In A the pair is C4 + F4, a perfect fourth of 5 semitones; in B it is B3 + F4, a diminished fifth of 6. The first and last pairs, C4 + E4, are identical.
svg.title: Same melody, one moment different: A above B

g.text: How to read this graphic: Both timelines share one time scale so a vertical line crosses
both at the same moment. The dashed outline covers 14 to 20 seconds. Inside it the two
bands have different colours; outside it they match.
